bands.label: Developing
bands.blurb: Real signal across most facets with visible, nameable gaps.

providers.name: Teledyne Technologies
providers.description: Teledyne Technologies Incorporated is a leading provider of sophisticated digital imaging products and software, instrumentation, aerospace and defense electronics, and engineered systems. Headquartered in Thousand Oaks, California, Teledyne serves the defense, commercial, and industrial markets. Key subsidiaries include Teledyne FLIR (thermal imaging cameras and systems), Teledyne LeCroy (oscilloscopes and protocol analyzers), Teledyne Imaging (scientific and industrial cameras), and Teledyne API (air quality monitoring instruments). Teledyne FLIR provides REST APIs and SDKs for thermal camera integration, while Teledyne LeCroy provides ActiveDSO and VISA-based automation APIs for test and measurement instruments.

bands.label: Thin
bands.blurb: Limited machine-readable signal beyond documentation a human can read.

providers.name: Airbus
providers.description: A European multinational aerospace corporation designing, manufacturing, and selling commercial aircraft, helicopters, defense, and space products. Through its Space Solutions / OneAtlas division Airbus publishes a developer API portal for satellite imagery, mapping, and elevation data.

providers.name: RTX
providers.description: RTX Corporation is a leading American aerospace and defense company comprising three market businesses: Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon. Raytheon develops the EAGLE (Enhanced Automated Graphical Logistics Environment) software platform for integrated logistics support and logistic support analysis across defense programs. RTX BBN Technologies (a Raytheon subsidiary) develops open-source software including SPARQL triple stores, NLP frameworks, and TAK ecosystem plugins for government and military situational awareness platforms.

providers.name: Motorola Solutions
providers.description: Motorola Solutions is a Fortune 500 company that provides developer APIs and integration capabilities through its developer platform. Motorola Solutions provides APIs for public safety communications, command center software, and video security integration. The platform enables partners to build on Motorola's public safety infrastructure.

bands.label: Emerging
bands.blurb: More than an index entry but still mostly links rather than artifacts.

providers.name: General Dynamics
providers.description: General Dynamics Corporation is a global aerospace and defense company headquartered in Reston, Virginia. The company operates across five business segments: Aerospace, Marine Systems, Combat Systems, Technologies, and Mission Systems, providing business aviation, ship construction, land combat vehicles, weapons systems, and technology products and services.

providers.name: TransDigm Group
providers.description: TransDigm Group is a leading global designer, producer, and supplier of highly engineered aerospace components, systems, and subsystems for use on nearly all commercial and military aircraft. The company operates 49 independent operating units producing proprietary, sole-source components including actuation systems, ignition systems, fuel systems, airframe and flight control components, cockpit security systems, seatbelts, airbags, pumps, valves, switches, and cockpit displays. TransDigm serves commercial airlines, defense OEMs, aerospace distributors, and the US Department of Defense.

providers.name: BWX Technologies
providers.description: BWX Technologies is a manufacturer of nuclear components and provider of nuclear services to the U.S. government and commercial customers worldwide. The company delivers innovative nuclear solutions across naval propulsion, small modular reactors, nuclear fuel, medical isotopes, and complex site operations.

providers.name: Boeing
providers.description: Boeing is an American multinational corporation that designs, manufactures, and sells airplanes, rotorcraft, rockets, satellites, and telecommunications equipment. Boeing Developer Tools provides aviation data APIs powered by Jeppesen aeronautical databases, covering aircraft models, airport data, airspace information, NOTAMs, flight events, and runway operations.

providers.name: CACI International
providers.description: CACI International provides information technology, professional services, and managed solutions to U.S. federal government agencies in the defense, intelligence, homeland security, and civilian markets. The company delivers expertise and technology across C3I, cyber, digital solutions, enterprise IT, mission support, space, and spectrum superiority domains.

providers.name: HEICO Corporation
providers.description: HEICO Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The HEICO Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Parsons Corporation
providers.description: Parsons Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Parsons Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Moog
providers.description: Moog Inc. is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and integrator of precision motion and fluid control products and solutions for aerospace, defense, industrial, and medical applications. Product divisions include actuation, motion systems, motors, propulsion, valves, aerospace components, and defense systems. Moog does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC)
providers.description: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) is a leading American technology integrator providing full life cycle services and solutions in the technical, engineering, and enterprise information technology markets. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC serves the U.S. federal government with approximately $7.4 billion in annual revenues. The company delivers IT modernization, cloud computing, digital transformation, cybersecurity, AI/ML, and data analytics solutions primarily for defense, intelligence, and civilian government customers. SAIC's open source presence is at github.com/saic-oss with DevSecOps tools including Anvil (CI/CD container) and terraform modules for Kubernetes sandboxes.

providers.name: BAE Systems
providers.description: BAE Systems is a British multinational defense, security, and aerospace company and one of the largest defense contractors globally. BAE Systems does not publish public developer APIs; technology integration is delivered through classified and ITAR-controlled customer programs, the Discover supplier portal, defense-program-specific data exchanges (e.g. F-35 ALIS / ODIN, Eurofighter), and FMS / government-to-government channels.

providers.name: Textron
providers.description: Textron Inc. is a $14.8 billion Fortune 500 multi-industry company employing 34,000 people worldwide. Textron operates through five business segments: Bell (military and commercial helicopters), Textron Aviation (Cessna, Beechcraft, Hawker aircraft), Industrial (Kautex fuel systems, Textron Specialized Vehicles including E-Z-GO and Jacobsen), Textron Systems (defense and autonomous systems), and Textron Financial. As of 2026, Textron does not offer publicly documented developer APIs or integration portals.

providers.name: L3Harris Technologies
providers.description: L3Harris Technologies is an agile global aerospace and defense technology innovator delivering end-to-end solutions in space, air, land, sea, and cyber domains for government and commercial customers. No publicly documented APIs are available; product integrations are delivered through customer engagements.

providers.name: Oshkosh
providers.description: Oshkosh Corporation is a Fortune 500 industrial company that designs and builds purpose-built vehicles and vehicle bodies, including access equipment, defense vehicles, fire and emergency apparatus, refuse collection vehicles, and concrete mixers.

providers.name: GE Aerospace
providers.description: A leading manufacturer of jet engines and aviation systems for commercial and military aircraft. Spun off from General Electric to focus exclusively on aerospace propulsion and services, GE Aerospace also offers software-as-a-service tooling, engine health monitoring (Collaborative Insight), TRUEngine certification, and OnPoint maintenance and support services.

providers.name: Raytheon
providers.description: Raytheon is an American aerospace and defense manufacturer operating as a business of RTX Corporation, the world's largest aerospace and defense company. Raytheon designs, develops, and produces advanced defense systems including precision weapons, air and missile defense systems, sensors, radar, electronic warfare, command-and-control solutions, and cyber capabilities for the U.S. military and allied governments worldwide. Key products include the Patriot missile defense system, StormBreaker smart weapons, RAIVEN electro-optical/infrared sensor suites, and advanced electronic attack systems. Raytheon also develops world-class logistics software through the EAGLE team supporting production management, technical manual development, and product support data. No public developer API or machine-readable specification is available at this time; Raytheon's software solutions are deployed within government program contracts.

providers.name: Rolls-Royce
providers.description: Rolls-Royce plc is a British multinational aerospace and defense company manufacturing aero engines (Trent series), defense propulsion, and power systems. Rolls-Royce does not publish a public developer API. The company operates supplier portals at suppliers.rolls-royce.com and maintains a small GitHub presence with the qc-cfd open-source repository covering quantum computing for computational fluid dynamics research.

providers.name: Leidos
providers.description: Leidos, a Fortune 500 digital and mission innovator, delivers solutions at the intersection of national security, health, and critical infrastructure. With a global workforce of approximately 47,000, the company is executing its NorthStar 2030 strategy focused on five growth engines: space and maritime, energy infrastructure, digital modernization and cyber, mission software, and managed health. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Benchmark Electronics
providers.description: Benchmark Electronics, Inc. is an advanced electronics engineering and manufacturing services (EMS) company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. The company provides integrated design, engineering, and manufacturing services from prototypes to high-volume production, including procurement, logistics, and repair. Benchmark serves original equipment manufacturers in defense, medical technologies, commercial aerospace, industrial, next-gen communications, advanced computing, and semiconductor capital equipment markets. The company operates approximately 22 locations in 8 countries with around 13,000 employees.

providers.name: Curtiss-Wright
providers.description: Curtiss-Wright is a global integrated business that provides highly engineered products, solutions, and services mainly to the aerospace, defense, commercial power, process, and general industrial markets. Its product portfolio spans rugged embedded computing, mission-critical avionics, electronic packaging, naval propulsion, reactor coolant pumps for nuclear power, surface treatment services, industrial valves, sensors, data acquisition systems, telemetry ground stations, emergency arresting systems for military aircraft, and electronic systems for naval shipbuilding programs. The company traces its lineage to the aviation pioneers Glenn Curtiss and the Wright brothers and today operates across the Defense Electronics, Naval & Power, and Aerospace & Industrial segments.

providers.name: KBR
providers.description: KBR is a Fortune 500 company that delivers science, technology, and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world, spanning defense, intelligence, space, energy transition, and sustainable infrastructure markets.

providers.name: Pratt & Whitney
providers.description: A major American aerospace manufacturer designing, manufacturing, and servicing aircraft engines for commercial, military, and business aviation applications. A division of RTX Corporation (formerly Raytheon Technologies), Pratt & Whitney is known for its geared turbofan (GTF) engine technology (PW1000G family) powering the Airbus A220 and A320neo, the F135 powering the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter, and the PT6 turboprop family. Customer-facing digital services - EngineWise health monitoring, FAST (Full-flight data Acquisition Storage and Transmission), and the Customer Portal - are operated privately for airline, MRO, and military customers behind credentialed access and are not exposed as a public developer API or open partner integration portal.

providers.name: Lockheed Martin
providers.description: Lockheed Martin is a leading global security, defense, and aerospace contractor. This repository captures the public APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts where they exist for Lockheed Martin.

providers.name: V2X
providers.description: V2X is a defense and national security contractor providing mission-critical solutions including AI integration, cybersecurity, advanced engineering, operations support, training, and modernization services. The company serves U.S. government, allied defense, and aerospace customers globally. V2X does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Huntington Ingalls Industries
providers.description: Huntington Ingalls Industries is the largest military shipbuilding company in the United States, designing, building, overhauling, and repairing ships primarily for the U.S. Navy and Coast Guard, while also providing professional services including unmanned systems, defense solutions, and cybersecurity. No public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Northrop Grumman
providers.description: Northrop Grumman is a global aerospace, defense, and security company that delivers innovative systems, products, and solutions in autonomous systems, cyber, command and control, space, and strike weapons.

providers.name: Viasat
providers.description: Profile for Viasat in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 972).
